description: This file defines an interface CustomerFacade that acts as a bridge between the CustomerService and Controller layers, handling customer data operations such as retrieval, registration, address management, and cart merging in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: Interface defining customer-related operations such as fetching, registering, address management, and cart merging in an e-commerce context.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on username, store, and language.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by customer ID.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges session shopping cart with customer's cart upon login.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves customer entity using username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the specified store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer with provided details.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address information for a customer, either billing or shipping.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates the address information for a customer.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties on a customer model based on store.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a customer with username and password.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Constructs a Customer object from PersistableCustomer.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates a Customer object with data from PersistableCustomer.
